question: Resolve model error versus independent Monte Carlo uncertainty in all originally eligible variance-channel validation conditions.
selection: All88 originally eligible nonzero-frequency variance rows, deduplicated by exact physical workpoint/channel; include matching DC. No selection by size or sign of error.
acceptance: Retain original pointwise tolerance .10 at<=25Hz and .15 above25Hz; use new independently measured DC denominator. Report originaleligible rows even if newDC SNR changes. Keep old results separately; no model fitting to new validation samples.
precision_target: Median AC complex SEM/DC<=.03 per variance channel; report failures and remaining uncertainty separately.
statistical_unit: Independent noise path; paired +/- and common streams across input conditions. Frequencies are not independent biological samples.
budget: One complete repeat at the registered precision; optional half-amplitude linearity check requires a separate bounded contract.
scope: Local response validation only. Does not repair candidate waveform failures, certify network propagation or establish a bifurcation.
